defect: filter input delay depends on an unstated board contract
rationale: The filter is synchronous, but the RTL gives no source-clock, trace, or interface specification for enable_i and filter_i. The selected input-delay window is therefore an environmental assumption that cannot be confirmed or rejected from the case.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the configurable filter to a three-sample history and a synchronous stored value.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Single clock, ports constrained, bypass path fits the period.
The filter has a combinational bypass from filter_i. Without a source launch and board-delay contract, the input window cannot be certified merely because a set_input_delay exists.
